headline: Says warships returning from Iran could stop off Cuba before Rubio 'finishes up the job'
dek: Trump: 'We may do another little Epic Fury, or they'll agree' -- 'Epic Fury' being the US military's name for the war against Iran (started Feb 28). In a TV interview the same day he described higher American petrol prices as a 'small price to pay' to prevent Iran acquiring nuclear weapons.
sources: US President Donald Trump, campaign rally in Fort Myers, Florida, Friday Oct 23
fault_line: Deal or Epic Fury? Audiences argue whether the strike threat is a negotiation lever or the actual plan -- and whether Americans will accept $117 oil as a 'small price'.

sections.what_happened: Trump: 'We may do another little Epic Fury, or they'll agree' -- 'Epic Fury' being the US military's name for the war against Iran (started Feb 28). In a TV interview the same day he described higher American petrol prices as a 'small price to pay' to prevent Iran acquiring nuclear weapons. He also said US warships returning from Iran would 'pass Cuba... stop about 50 yards off the coast' before 'Marco Rubio' goes in 'to finish up the job'. Iran's reply: 'don't play with fire' (TOI). Rapidan's Bob McNally warned crude could reach ~$150/bbl if the conflict escalates (Times Now, analyst quote).
sections.what_verified: On-record rally quotes carried by Reuters; Axios (via Indian Express live blog); NDTV/Times of India family.
sections.what_disputed: Hours after envoy Barrack said a strike was 'Absolutely' possible this weekend, Trump said 'I don't know anything about it'. Trump previously said no attack before the Nov 3 midterms. Channel 12: US and Israeli officials assessed the situation had not yet reached a point requiring immediate action (reported via CGTN).
sections.why_matters: Trump promises 'another little Epic Fury' -- then calls rising gas prices a 'small price to pay'. Ten days to the midterms, with Brent at $117.
sections.context: Background: NEW (big-missed, on record ~23:00 Oct 23) -- Trump at Florida rally: 'We may do another little Epic Fury, or they'll agree'; calls rising US fuel prices a 'small price to pay' to stop Iran's nukes; says warships returning from Iran could stop off Cuba before Rubio 'finishes up the job'

totw_analysis: Our read: Trump promises 'another little Epic Fury' -- then calls rising gas prices a 'small price to pay'. Ten days to the midterms, with Brent at $117. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deal or Epic Fury? Audiences argue whether the strike threat is a negotiation lever or the actual plan -- and whether Americans will accept $117 oil as a 'small price'.
